title: Web access-point readiness and HTTP-front neutrality
summary: An HTTP page or WebSocket 101 proves transport/bootstrap only. A Wire Web view is ready only after semantic bootstrap, exact definition/resource readiness and authoritative snapshot/revision synchronization succeed.
readiness_stages: view synchronized and semantic actions enabled
invariants: HTTP front may be Node, ooRexx HTTP/HTTPS or another conforming static/bootstrap front without acquiring application authority.
Do not report a WebSocket 101 as a live synchronized Wire view.
SOURCE or another semantic surface being alive does not prove DESIGN or every other projected surface is populated.
HTTP/static delivery must not become a second business API.

provenance.claim: Builder continuity records HTTP-front qualification and truthful browser session readiness.
